gloss: fourth-year student; fourth grader; final-year student (university)

definitions.gloss: fourth-year student; fourth grader; final-year student (university)
definitions.explanation: A student in their fourth year of a school. In elementary school refers to a 9–10-year-old, and in a four-year Japanese university refers to a final-year student preparing for graduation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小学|しょうがく}→小学：29351_shougaku⟧{四年生|よねんせい}だ。
examples.english: My son is a fourth grader in elementary school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧{四年生|よねんせい}になって⟦{就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう}→就職活動：14840_shuushokukatsudou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: I became a fourth-year university student and job hunting began.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{四年生|よねんせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{卒業論文|そつぎょうろんぶん}→卒業論文：09259_sotsugyouronbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}き→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: Fourth-year university students write their graduation thesis while also taking corporate job interviews.

notes:
Formed from {四年|よねん} (fourth year) + {生|せい} (student). Read よねんせい, not しねんせい — the ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧ reading is used for 4 to avoid the unlucky-sounding し.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{小学|しょうがく}→小学：29351_shougaku⟧{四年生|よねんせい}: fourth-grade elementary student
- ⟦{中学|ちゅうがく}→中学：03477_chuugaku⟧{四年生|よねんせい}: rare; junior high is only three years
- ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧{四年生|よねんせい}: fourth-year university student (final year)
- {四年生|よねんせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a fourth-year student

USAGE:
In Japan, elementary school lasts six years and university four years, so {四年生|よねんせい} most commonly refers to either a 9–10-year-old or a graduating university student. Japanese universities use ⟦{一年生|いちねんせい}→一年生：27559_ichinensei⟧ through {四年生|よねんせい} rather than "freshman/senior" terminology.
